headline: D. P. Abhushan issues corrigendum for EGM and alters proposed allottees
hook: Allottee changes made ahead of EGM
summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited announced the outcome of its board meeting held on October 23, 2026. The company approved the substitution of proposed allottees and issued a corrigendum to the notice of its Extra Ordinary General Meeting (EGM) No. 01/2026-27. This procedural update alters the share allocation framework prior to the shareholder vote. Retail investors holding the stock should note the administrative changes ahead of the upcoming EGM.
why_it_matters: Procedural changes ahead of EGM for small-cap equity holders

headline: D.P. Abhushan calls EGM for October 29, 2026
hook: Notice issued for upcoming extraordinary meet
summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited has formally informed the stock exchange about convening an Extraordinary General Meeting of its shareholders. The meeting is scheduled to take place on October 29, 2026. The company's notice details the upcoming shareholder interaction. Retail investors should track corporate disclosures for the specific agenda items to be voted upon.
why_it_matters: Upcoming shareholder vote may impact company governance or strategy.

headline: D.P. Abhushan announces issue of equity shares and warrants on preferential basis
hook: Preferential equity and warrant issuance announced
summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges about its plan to issue equity shares and warrants on a preferential basis. Preferential issues allow listed companies to allot shares or convertible securities to specific investors, often promoters or strategic backers, at a determined price. This corporate action can alter the existing shareholding pattern and capital structure of the firm. Indian retail investors tracking jewellery stocks should note how preferential allotments impact equity dilution and promoter holding.
whats_next: Shareholder approval and pricing details for the preferential issue
why_it_matters: Preferential allotment alters equity dilution and promoter holding levels.
